UT Code 6.11C supplies a valuation-specific standard. Importing it as the general tokenisation supervisory standard requires additional authority. Retaining responsibility does not expressly require personally performing every outsourced task or reserving every operational decision.

Paragraph 14 most naturally conditions demonstration on an SFC request while leaving confirmation unconditioned. Footnote 5 may elaborate that demonstration or, read independently, suggest an unqualified expectation. The reach of the SFC-satisfaction and high-confidence standards should remain explicit and unresolved where ambiguous.

No SFC request does not establish substantive compliance or suspend paragraph 10 responsibility. Paragraph 15 concerns requested audit or verification; paragraph 16 separately concerns a requested satisfactory legal opinion. Neither obtaining an audit nor obtaining an opinion proves substantive fulfillment.

UT Code 6.8 permits register maintenance by the identified scheme, trustee or appointee without displacing the provider's retained responsibility. The separate intermediary issuance provision also preserves responsibility despite outsourcing, but its actor and issuance conditions must not be silently transferred to this question.
Complete paragraphs 10–13, footnote 2 and applicable Appendix factors are absent. The supplied intermediary paragraph 13 is not established to be the paragraph 13 referenced by footnote 5.
